messages:
Maya R.: hi all, on my first day trying to finish SSO. Okta keeps throwing 'No authenticators available' when I try to add a passkey with my Yubi. Anyone seen this during onboarding?
Diego (IT): hey Maya, welcome! which Yubi model and which browser? sometimes the USB fallback gets blocked by mac privacy.
Maya R.: Yubi 5 NFC, macOS 14.1, Brave browser. Not on VPN. I tried inserting the key and it vibrates but browser says nothing.
Rina P.: FYI I had a similar thing and switching to Chrome fixed it for me. Also check System Settings -> Privacy -> Security -> Accessibility/Full Disk for Yubico Authenticator if you're using the app.
Maya R.: tried Chrome private window too, same message. 1Password shows my SSO account as active though, but Okta UI never lists any registered authenticators.
Onboard Bot: New hire provisioning: google workspace account created; okta user created; 1password invite sent. If registration fails, an IT rep will attempt reprovision after 15 minutes.
Diego (IT): i'm going to check our provisioning logs. Maya, can you confirm your Okta username (email) so I can force a re-sync? No passwords.
Maya R.: maya.robinson@redwood.dev
Diego (IT): thanks. i'm seeing a 'deferred device registration' event in the sync logs for us-east-1  triggered around 1955551000. trying a manual sync now.
Diego (IT): manual sync complete. also disabled 'require resident key' for your account temporarily to allow a non-resident passkey register. Try again and tell me the exact error text if it fails.
Maya R.: reattempting... error now says: "Operation failed: authenticatorResponse missing clientDataJSON"
Rina P.: that error used to mean the browser blocked access to USB devices. Did Brave show a little icon in the address bar asking to allow security key?
Maya R.: i didn't see anything. I tried the Yubi NFC too with my phone but Okta won't accept phone tap in this flow.
Diego (IT): okay, i pushed a temporary whitelist for your session and reissued the 1Password invite so we can confirm SSO via a separate path. Also restarting the Okta auth proxy for your session.
Onboard Bot: 1Password invite resent to maya.robinson+ssobypass@personalmail.com (alternate address on file).
Maya R.: got the alternate invite, signed in there and could access the vault. Attempting Okta passkey register one more time...
Maya R.: success, registered a passkey via Chrome. logging into GitHub/Slack with SSO worked too. thanks! :party_parrot:
Diego (IT): awesome. i'll update the onboarding checklist: if 'clientDataJSON' error occurs, try Chrome, clear site data for okta.com, and IT will force a manual sync + temporary resident-key toggle as needed. Adding note about Brave weirdness.
People Ops Bot: Thanks for the report, Maya! People Ops will follow up with a 1-week onboarding pulse. Welcome to Redwood Inference! :sparkles:
Maya R.: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick help.
